thread:
elsa_support: Customer reports no welcome credits after signup. Flow: email verify -> Apple Sign In -> added GPay (same browser session). Email: alice+acct3@example.com, user_id: u_8242. They finished 2FA and payment succeeded, but credits missing. Any quick checks? :confused:

mike_payments: Can you paste the pm id and the payment provider response? Also did they see any 'autogrant skipped' message?

elsa_support: PM id: pm_7gh3k. Provider: GPay via stripe. Stripe returned success: {"status":"ok","card_country":"US","bin_country":"US"}. User IP during signup: 83.45.12.9 (EU ISP). IP when PM attached: 34.201.9.77 (us-east-1).

sara_eng: Hmm region flip. Our autogrant checks email_domain_region + signup_ip_region + pm_bin_region. If mismatch we gate. Let me check logs.

autogrant-bot: autogrant_check: user_id=u_8242, email_region=EU, signup_ip_region=EU, pm_bin_region=US -> RESULT=SKIP_REASON=pm_region_mismatch

mike_payments: That bot log explains it. Why did pm_bin_region=US? Because GPay tokenized a US card. But user was EU from IP and email. Our rule is conservative for fraud.

elsa_support: Customer insists they are EU and their card is valid EU billing — they used a US-issuing virtual card though. They expected manual review path.

jordan_ops: Did the signup include a redirect that could flip region (CDN edge)? We had an incident last month where some mobile carriers routed via US proxies. I'll check request traces.

sara_eng: Querying signup trace. SQL: ```SELECT ts, ip, region, event FROM signup_events WHERE user_id='u_8242' ORDER BY ts;``` Result: 3 rows -> email_verification (ts=2311112330, ip=83.45.12.9, region=EU), pm_attach (ts=2311112338, ip=34.201.9.77, region=US), post_verify_redirect (ts=2311112340, ip=34.201.9.77, region=US)

mike_payments: So PM attach happened after a cross-region redirect. Autogrant ran at pm_attach time and skipped. That should have triggered a manual review workflow, but maybe the manual queue didn't get the task. Check manual_review.tasks for that user.

sara_eng: Manual queue check: ```SELECT status, created_at FROM manual_review_tasks WHERE user_id='u_8242';``` -> returns empty. Looks like the autogrant SKIP didn't enqueue review; bug.

elsa_support: Customer asked for credits now. Can we grant manually?

mike_payments: Ops can do an emergency grant. Admin console command: `admin_panel.grant_credits("u_8242", 50, "manual grant - pm_region_mismatch; support escalated")`

jordan_ops: Before granting, can we reconcile fraud flags? What does fraud-service say for pm_7gh3k?

sara_eng: Fraud call: `GET /fraud/v1/check?user=u_8242&pm=pm_7gh3k` -> response `{"risk_score":12,"block":false,"notes":["pm_bin_country:US","ip_country:EU","session_geo_mismatch"]}`. Low risk. OK to grant.

autogrant-bot: autogrant_resolution: manual_override_allowed=true for user_id=u_8242 per policy V2.

mike_payments: I'm going to ask ops to apply the grant and also patch the manual queue bug. @jordan_ops can you run the grant and open a hotfix?

jordan_ops: Will do. Granting now... `> admin_panel.grant_credits("u_8242",50,"support manual override - pm_region_mismatch")` -> success. User balance updated.

elsa_support: Nice. Can you also DM me the ticket id so I can confirm with the customer?

jordan_ops: Ticket created: MR-4579, assigned to @sara_eng for root cause. Also created hotfix PR to ensure autogrant SKIP enqueues manual_review when skip_reason in [pm_region_mismatch, ip_region_mismatch].

sara_eng: Notes for PR: ensure we enqueue `manual_review_tasks` on SKIP; add metrics for skipped_autogrant->queued_manual_review. Adding unit test for same-session cross-region pm_attach.

mike_payments: Follow-up: Suggest we relax gate to allow welcome credits when risk_score < 20 even if pm_bin_region != signup_region. Reduces manual reviews for virtual cards. Filing proposal doc.

elsa_support: Customer confirmed they now see 50 credits. Marking thread resolved. Closing with note to update help article about "why credits may be gated". :white_check_mark:
